payload.title: Handle missing witness completion throughout versioned U2 analysis
payload.summary: Priority2 analysis-reuse correctness. Immutable Case0012 stage_d.analysis.completion explicitly returns None for a missing witness member, but comparisons calls delta(None,None), raising TypeError; frozen_gates, attribution, required_records and reporting also assume complete reachable support. The existing missing-completion test exercises only the helper. Independent AST-extracted pure-function probe reproduces the downstream TypeError without running original science. All original selected A/B/C completions are present, so no historical verdict corruption is demonstrated. Leave sealed Case0012 code, inputs and outcomes unchanged; correct only an explicitly versioned future analyzer or report-only adapter when a real consumer is authorized.
payload.benefit: Acceptance: independently authored tiny inputs cover baseline-incomplete, treatment-incomplete, both-incomplete, unavailable unit support, empty task-backed witnesses, mixed complete/incomplete alternatives and zero denominators through the whole selected metrics/gates/report path. Preserve None/NOT_ASSESSED without invented rank, prefix, zero cost or passing support. Explicitly report a contract-defect or bounded unsupported-version result when required accounting is unassessable. Bind source, task, plan, witness and artifact schemas; preserve exact unchanged-original compatibility in a versioned read-only adapter. No original retrieval, adjudication or reports are rerun or rewritten. A future maintenance agent can implement only after caller/schema scope and scientific authority are approved.
